name: Altar Of Burnt Offering The
overview: The Altar of Burnt Offering, as detailed in Exodus 27:1-6, was constructed from shittim wood and overlaid with brass, measuring five cubits square and three cubits high. It featured horns on each corner and was equipped with brass vessels and a brass network grate supported beneath the altar, designed precisely according to divine instructions. This altar served as the central place for all sacrifices, emphasizing the importance of purity and reverence in worship, with all offerings and related utensils made of brass to symbolize holiness and durability.
